Avoid at all costs (this one and the entire street)
Mar 2025 • Couples
Such a waste of (a lot for HCM standards) money! Don’t go here, it’s a tourist trap for sure. We had 2 cocktails that weren’t tasty at all. We had an entree of chicken which was uneatable, so we didn’t touch it after tasting it. The main dish (squid) was so tough and very dry. The fried rice was OK-ish, but not even good. So overall: avoid this restaurant and for that matter the entire street, because all the restaurants are actually 1. They cook the dishes in seperate restaurants and then serve it to you. You can see the menus are all identical. There are so many good places to eat in HCM, just avoid this street :)
